# Know Your Meme

> > Know Your Meme is the definitive encyclopedia documenting internet culture, viral memes, TikTok trends, and social media phenomena across platforms like Twitter/X, Reddit, and YouTube.

This site serves as a comprehensive database tracking the origins, evolution, and cultural impact of internet memes, from classic image macros to modern TikTok dance trends. Each entry provides detailed context, examples, and spread analysis for viral content.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Internet slang and catchphrases
- Viral meme explanations
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Dance memes and challenges
- Pop culture references
- Breaking Bad and TV show memes
- Hood culture and 90s nostalgia
- Mental health humor
- Looksmaxxing and internet subcultures
- Conspiracy theories
- Millennial culture
- Heartbreaking and relatable memes

## Trending Memes & Viral Phenomena

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman confusion
- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl lying in dirt, viral on TikTok
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme viral on TikTok with lip-dub trend
- [Millennial Burger Place](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): Millennial burger restaurant cliche meme & TikTok starter pack trend

## TikTok Trends & Dance Challenges

- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swim gesture
